units: <cite ref="Shabbat 98b:4">Sabb. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>דשָׁפֵי להו כי טורין</he> they made the boards slanting like mountain sides (bringing to a point; Ar. <cite ref="I00780"><he>טָרִיז</he></cite> q. v.); Yalk. Ex. 370.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 115b">B. Kam. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>אפשר … וש׳ ליה</he> (not <he>דש׳</he>) one may put something (a piece of cloth &c.) over the mouth of a jug, and pour (strain) the liquid through.
<cite ref="Shabbat 139b:18">Sabb. 139ᵇ</cite> <he>שָׁפוּ שיכרא וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>שָׁאפוּ</he>) they poured beer slowly from vessel to vessel (leaving the dregs behind); a. e.—
Kidd. 71ᵇ שָׁפֵי חלא vinegar dealer, v. שָׁפֵיחָלָא.—Trnsf. to let the blood flow after bloodletting.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:22">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>דלמא ש׳ ליה וכ׳</he> perhaps the surgeon may bleed him too long &c.
